settings.sLevelDefault: The results of hard work and dedication always look like luck to saps. But you know you've earned every ounce of your success.
settings.sLevelDoneWarning: You need to finish distributing attribute points before leaving the menu.
settings.sLevelPopUpText: To increase your level, make progress learning your class's major skills.
settings.sLevelUp10: You woke today with a new sense of purpose. You're no longer afraid of failure. Failure is just an opportunity to learn something new.
settings.sLevelUp11: Being smart doesn't hurt. And a little luck now and then is nice. But the key is patience and hard work. And when it pays off, it's SWEET!
settings.sLevelUp12: You can't believe how easy it is. You just have to go -- a little crazy. And then, suddenly, it all makes sense, and everything you do turns to gold.
settings.sLevelUp13: It's the most amazing thing. Yesterday it was hard, and today it is easy. Just a good night's sleep, and yesterday's mysteries are today's masteries.
settings.sLevelUp14: Today you wake up, full of energy and ideas, and you know, somehow, that overnight everything has changed. What a difference a day makes.
settings.sLevelUp15: Today you suddenly realized the life you've been living, the punishment your body has taken -- there are limits to what the body can do, and perhaps you have reached them. You've wondered what it is like to grow old. Well, now you know.
settings.sLevelUp16: You've been trying too hard, thinking too much. Relax. Trust your instincts. Just be yourself. Do the little things, and the big things take care of themselves.
settings.sLevelUp17: Life isn't over. You can still get smarter, or cleverer, or more experienced, or meaner -- but your body and soul just aren't going to get any younger.
settings.sLevelUp18: Today you suddenly realized the life you've been living, the punishment your body has taken -- there are limits to what the body can do, and perhaps you have reached them. You've wondered what it is like to grow old. Well, now you know.
settings.sLevelUp19: You've been trying too hard, thinking too much. Relax. Trust your instincts. Just be yourself. Do the little things, and the big things take care of themselves.
settings.sLevelUp2: You realize that all your life you have been coasting along as if you were in a dream. Suddenly, facing the trials of the last few days, you have come alive.
settings.sLevelUp20: Life isn't over. You can still get smarter, or cleverer, or more experienced, or meaner -- but your body and soul just aren't going to get any younger.
settings.sLevelUp3: You realize that you are catching on to the secret of success. It's just a matter of concentration.
settings.sLevelUp4: It's all suddenly obvious to you. You just have to concentrate. All the energy and time you've wasted -- it's a sin. But without the experience you've gained, taking risks, taking responsibility for failure, how could you have understood?
settings.sLevelUp5: Everything you do is just a bit easier, more instinctive, more satisfying. It is as though you had suddenly developed keen senses and instincts.
settings.sLevelUp6: You sense yourself more aware, more open to new ideas. You've learned a lot about Cyrodiil. It's hard to believe how ignorant you were -- but now you have so much more to learn.
settings.sLevelUp7: You resolve to continue pushing yourself. Perhaps there's more to you than you thought.
settings.sLevelUp8: The secret does seem to be hard work, yes, but it's also a kind of blind passion, an inspiration.
settings.sLevelUp9: So that's how it works. You plod along, putting one foot before the other, look up, and suddenly, there you are. Right where you wanted to be all along.
